_comment: LINE user ids allowed to use the cast room log.
Collect an id by having the person send any message to the LINE official
account: api/line-webhook.js forwards their user id to Telegram. Paste it
into `allow` below, with the person's name alongside it in `who` so the
list stays readable a year from now, then deploy.
An id looks like U followed by 32 hex characters. Anything that does not
match that shape is rejected at startup rather than silently never
matching. LINE_ALLOWED_USER_IDS in the environment is merged with this
list, for granting access without a deploy.
